a.lede: New York City mayor Zohran Mamdani weighed in on the corporate turbulence surrounding Nvidia and the chipmaker’s chief executive officer, Jensen Huang, saying he does not think working Americans 'signed up for their pensions being tied to the question of Huang’s fidelity to his marriage'. The mayor said Huang 'had a massive impact', with Nvidia’s share price dropping dramatically after
a.title: Mamdani questions AI economy as Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia – video

b.lede: An Nvidia robotics engineer that quit in response to Jensen Huang's resignation says he "may have moved too quickly" now that CEO is back in charge.
b.title: Nvidia engineer who quit over Jensen Huang's exit says he 'may have moved too quickly'
